mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates applied to equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the monetary policy environment becomes more accommodative.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window for FEDFUNDS predicting 20-day SPX returns.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 5.2% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as recession risks increase.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >55% of months when UNRATE > 5.2%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.5%) combined with low policy rates (FEDFUNDS < 3.5%) signals imminent monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to rising discount rates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.5% and FEDFUNDS < 3.5%, or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, declining housing starts (HOUST < 2000 thousand units) indicate weakening consumer demand, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as economic momentum fades.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, SPX 60-day returns are positive in >55% of months when HOUST < 2000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Higher industrial production (INDPRO) reflects robust economic activity, supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings growth accelerates.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window for INDPRO predicting 20-day SPX returns.

mechanism_narrative: Strong retail sales (RSAFS > 355,000 million dollars) indicate resilient consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days through elevated corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >55% of months when RSAFS > 355000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent high unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%) and low payrolls (PAYEMS < 130,000 thousand) signal a deteriorating labor market, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced consumer spending confidence.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >55% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0% and PAYEMS < 130000, or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

failure_condition: In early-cycle expansions, SPX 60-day returns are negative in >55% of months when INDPRO > 120, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
